description: Agent-based, network-coupled social-behavior and epidemic simulation of mask adoption dynamics under social influence, policy, information campaigns, and supply constraints, with optional transmission dynamics.

modules.name: SocialNetworkModule
modules.description: Construct and optionally rewire the person-person contact network (small-world by default) and provide adjacency for social influence.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  build small_world_graph(N=population_size, k=avg_degree, beta=rewiring_rate)
  compute clustering; adjust by adding triangles until target clustering_coefficient achieved (heuristic)
  store adjacency, degree
else:
  with probability rewiring_rate per edge: rewire edge to random node preserving degree distribution
  update adjacency, degree
notes: Small-world network via Watts-Strogatz, then tuning clustering by local triangle closure.
Rewiring allows dynamic social ties (e.g., online/offline shifts).

modules.name: InformationAndCampaignModule
modules.description: Broadcast information from media and campaigns, update individual risk perception and trust; propagate social information via network.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  media_signal = campaign_intensity * (1 - misinformation_rate) * info_source_weight_media
  social_signal = mean(mask_wearing of neighbors) * info_source_weight_social
  trust_delta = trust_update_rate * (media_trust_modifier + trust_modifier_from_channels)
  current_risk_perception[i] = clamp( baseline_risk_perception + media_signal + social_signal + (mandate_active? 0.1 : 0.0), 0, 1)
  trust_in_institutions[i] = clamp( trust_in_institutions[i] + trust_delta - misinformation_rate*0.1 + counter_misinformation_intensity*0.05, 0, 1 )
notes: Neighbors' mask wearing acts as social risk signal.
Mandates increase perceived risk modestly (policy salience).
Trust evolves slower than risk (trust_update_rate).

modules.name: PolicyEnforcementModule
modules.description: Controls mandate state, enforcement actions, and fines; updates location-level enforcement effects.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  mandate_active = mandate_active
else:
  # Optional reactive policy (could be disabled by freezing params)
  if moving_average(incidence,7) > threshold_high and not mandate_active: mandate_active = True
  elif moving_average(incidence,7) < threshold_low and mandate_active: mandate_active = False
# Enforcement probability can be modulated by location strictness
enforcement_probability_effective = enforcement_probability * location_enforcement_multiplier
conduct_spot_checks at locations with probability spot_check_rate_per_location
notes: Reactive toggling can be disabled in runs by freezing mandate_active and setting thresholds outside range.
Spot checks result in fines for non-compliance (handled in AdoptionDecisionModule deterrence).

modules.name: RetailSupplyModule
modules.description: Manages mask inventories, restocking, and price adjustments; records sales and stockouts.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer r:
  # fulfill demand
  sold = min(stock_level[r], demand[r])
  stock_level[r] -= sold
  record sold by quality according to quality_mix
  if stock_level[r] == 0: record stockout event
  # restock
  restock_amount = retail_restock_rate_per_day * initial_stock_reference
  if stock_level[r] == 0: restock_amount *= stockout_penalty_restock_multiplier
  stock_level[r] += restock_amount
  # price adjustment based on excess demand
  demand_supply_ratio = (demand[r]+1e-6)/(stock_level[r]+1e-6)
  mask_price[r] *= exp(price_elasticity * (demand_supply_ratio-1))
  apply quality-specific price multipliers
notes: initial_stock_reference = retailer_initial_stock_per_1000*(population_size/1000)/num_retailers
Price elasticities are negative; price increases when demand>stock.

modules.name: HouseholdInfluenceModule
modules.description: Applies intra-household norm reinforcement and resource sharing of masks.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each household h:
  mean_use = mean(mask_wearing of members)
  norms_on_mask_use[h] = clamp( norms_on_mask_use[h] + household_norm_influence_weight*(mean_use - norms_on_mask_use[h]), 0, 1)
  # sharing
  total_masks = sum(stock_of_masks[h])
  redistribute minimally so that members who intend to wear but lack a mask obtain one with probability intra_household_sharing_rate
notes: Norms converge towards observed average behavior.
Sharing mitigates short-term supply gaps.

modules.name: AdoptionDecisionModule
modules.description: Computes each person's decision to wear a mask and whether to purchase one, accounting for social influence, risk, policy, fatigue/habit, and affordability.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  neighbor_use = mean(mask_wearing of neighbors)
  score = social_influence_weight*neighbor_use + risk_perception_weight*current_risk_perception[i] + policy_compliance_weight*(mandate_active?1:0)
  # deterrence
  deterrence = enforcement_deterrence_sensitivity * enforcement_probability_effective
  score += deterrence
  # fatigue and habit
  score = score - fatigue_rate_per_day*fatigue_level[i] + habit_formation_rate_per_day*(past_use[i])
  # affordability
  affordability = 1 - affordability_sensitivity * (mask_price / income_scaled[i])
  # final decision
  p_wear = sigmoid( (score + affordability - adoption_threshold) / max(compliance_noise_std, 1e-3) )
  decide_wear = Bernoulli(p_wear)
  if decide_wear and mask_ownership[i] == 0:
    request 1 mask from nearest retailer (by id mod) and set demand
  mask_wearing_state[i] = decide_wear and (mask_ownership[i] > 0)
  update fatigue_level[i] and past_use[i]
notes: Sigmoid smooths the threshold rule; set compliance_noise_std low to approximate hard threshold.
Income_scaled is SES normalized to [0,1] with floor.
Deterrence only effective under perceived enforcement.

modules.name: LocationActivityAndTransmissionModule
modules.description: Generates daily attendance at locations and simulates infection transmission conditioned on masks and ventilation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if not enable_transmission: return
assign individuals to locations per daily_schedule and schedule_outside_activity_rate
for each location L:
  compute contact_rate = base_contacts(L.type) * lcm_type(L.type) * (1 - ventilation_effect_scaler*ventilation_level[L])
  compute effective_mask_block = 1 - [(1 - mask_source_control_efficacy)^(frac_masked_source*contacts)] * [(1 - mask_wearer_protection_efficacy)^(frac_masked_susceptible*contacts)]
  beta_eff = baseline_transmission_rate * contact_rate * (1 - effective_mask_block)
  adjust beta for vaccination: susceptible_beta = beta_eff * (1 - vaccine_efficacy_susceptibility)
  new_infections_L = Binomial(S_susceptible_in_L, 1 - exp(-beta_eff * I_infectious_in_L / max(N_L,1))) with vaccination modifying susceptibility
sum new_infections over locations
update SEIR/SIR states with infectious_period_days and asymptomatic_fraction
notes: Mass-action within locations with modifiers for masks and ventilation.
Vaccination reduces susceptibility and infectiousness (latter via vaccine_efficacy_infectiousness applied to infected mask wearers).

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates mask adoption and subgroup differences; records purchases and stockouts.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(mask_wearing_state)
if adoption_rate >= 0.5 and first_time_reached == False: time_to_50 = t; first_time_reached = True
masks_purchased_cum += sum(masks_sold)
stockout_events_daily = count(stockouts today)
# subgroup gap by SES quartiles
q_low = quantile(SES, subgroup_low_quantile); q_high = quantile(SES, subgroup_high_quantile)
rate_low = mean(mask_wearing_state[SES<=q_low])
rate_high = mean(mask_wearing_state[SES>=q_high])
subgroup_adoption_gap_income = rate_high - rate_low
mean_compliance_under_mandate = mean(adoption_rate over days with mandate_active)
notes: time_to_50_adoption computed once when first crossing occurs.
SES quantiles configurable.

modules.name: EpidemicAggregator
modules.description: Computes Rt, incident cases, peak incidence, and infections averted vs. counterfactual no-mask scenario.

update_rule.pseudocode:
incident_cases_daily[t] = sum(new_infections)
Rt_daily[t] = renewal_method(incidence=incident_cases_daily, w=Gamma(mean=generation_interval_mean, sd=generation_interval_sd), window=smoothing_window_Rt)
peak_incidence_value = max(incident_cases_daily[0:t])
# Counterfactual averted estimation via same contacts but zero mask effect factor
beta_cf_factor = 1 - counterfactual_mask_effectiveness  # usually 1 (no mask protection)
incidence_cf[t] = simulate_one_step_counterfactual(incident_cases_daily[t-1], beta_scaler=beta_cf_factor)
cumulative_infections_averted = sum(incidence_cf) - sum(incident_cases_daily)
notes: Renewal method for Rt uses smoothed incidence.
Counterfactual uses a one-step projection with mask effects removed; for precise estimates, pair with dedicated no-mask run.
